Name: Machir, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Machir was the son of Manasseh and the grandson of Joseph, born in Egypt.
KeyStory: Machir's children were born on Joseph's knees, a sign of Joseph's joy in his grandchildren before he died.
RelatedPeople: Manasseh; Joseph, Son of Jacob; Ephraim
LifeLesson: Seeing grandchildren is one of God's quiet mercies in a long life.
